blockingIssues.description: serialize_interactivity_props only serializes `tab_stop` when true, so explicit `tab_stop(false)` overrides are dropped. Host reconstruction applies `tab_index` first, making the surface focusable when it should not be.
After error-state tree clearing, subsequent `RenderDelta` messages can trigger remote view close instead of recovery because delta handling treats missing trees as closed views.

appliedUpdates.description: Added `test_codex_usage_plugin_mirror` command alias for codex fixture mirror tests used during plugin-canvas feature validation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When mirroring interactive props, serialize boolean fields with meaningful false overrides explicitly (for example, preserve `tab_stop(false)` even when `tab_index` is set).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of plugin-canvas-input-focus-and-rerender found false tab-stop overrides dropped in `gpui_plugin` serialization while host applies `tab_index` before optional tab-stop override, creating focus parity regressions.
